premises: Increasing Al and Cr content in AlCoCrFeNi reduces effective diffusion barriers for scale-forming elements.
Reduced diffusion barriers promote rapid formation of a continuous, compact, and adherent Al2O3/Cr2O3 scale.
This protective scale reduces inward oxygen flux and enhances oxidation resistance.
Atomistic simulations can predict diffusion barriers and oxide formation kinetics for varying compositions.
The high-Al/Cr variant will show a thinner, denser, more adherent scale and lower oxidation rates than the baseline.
